title: Global Structure and Local Specifications in Sublinear Valuation
abstract: arXiv:2609.37881v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This work studies the relationships among sublinear valuation rules, uncertainty structures, and local specifications in a time-homogeneous Markovian framework with killing. These objects are linked, under finiteness and locality of the upper generator and a Lyapunov condition, by three maps: robust valuation, globalization, and localization. First, we show that the corresponding classes of uncertainty structures and sublinear valuation rules are order-isomorphic via the robust valuation map. Second, our analysis clarifies how local specifications constrain sublinear valuation and uncertainty structures, as well as what information localization and globalization preserve. In particular, the compositions of localization and globalization need not recover the original objects but yield canonical extremal elements. translated_title: 次线性估值中的全局结构与局部规范
translated_abstract: 本文研究了在带终止（killing）的时齐马尔可夫框架下，次线性估值规则、不确定性结构与局部规范三者之间的关系。在上生成子的有限性与局部性条件以及一个Lyapunov条件下，这些对象通过三个映射相互联系起来：稳健估值、全局化与局部化。首先，我们证明了相应的不确定性结构类与次线性估值规则类通过稳健估值映射构成序同构。其次，我们的分析阐明了局部规范如何约束次线性估值与不确定性结构，以及局部化与全局化各自保留了哪些信息；特别地，局部化与全局化的复合未必能恢复原始对象，而是产生典范的极值元素。第三，由局部规范生成的次线性估值由……的最大粘性下解所刻画（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 在带终止的时齐马尔可夫框架下，本文证明不确定性结构与次线性估值规则通过稳健估值映射构成序同构，并刻画了局部规范对估值的约束作用，以及局部化与全局化复合所产生的典范极值元素。
en_tdlr: In a time-homogeneous Markovian framework with killing, this paper establishes an order-isomorphism between uncertainty structures and sublinear valuation rules via the robust valuation map, and characterizes how local specifications constrain valuation, with localization-globalization compositions yielding canonical extremal elements.
